company.name: Tidewell Outdoor
company.summary: Tidewell Outdoor is an online shop for outdoor and camping gear based in Gothenburg, Sweden. You sell about 3,000 products to consumers and handle many order, return, and sizing questions by email. Your team of 15 covers customer service, marketing, purchasing, warehouse, and one developer.
offerings: Camping gear, including tents, sleeping bags, and cooking equipment
Online order, return, and exchange service
Sizing and product advice by email
company.customers: Consumers in Sweden and nearby Nordic and EU markets who buy outdoor and camping gear online.

strategy.situation: Tidewell Outdoor sells about 3,000 outdoor products online with a 15-person team in Gothenburg. Most customer questions, returns, stock checks, and reporting still run through email and manual Shopify work.
strategy.complication: Order and sizing emails arrive faster than your team can answer, and late parcels create repeat contacts that cost time and trust. As sales grow, the same manual steps will absorb more hours without adding capacity.
strategy.governing_thought: Start with three agents for order status and returns, sizing advice, and late parcel tracking; they cut your team’s repetitive email and parcel work and prove value fast.

key_arguments.headline: Customer service and logistics absorb most of the repetitive email and parcel work
key_arguments.support: Your four-person customer service team spends much of each day on order status, returns, exchanges, and sizing questions. The logistics coordinator also spends hours tracking late parcels and updating delivery status. Marketing and purchasing have recurring listing, stock, and reporting chores, but they are smaller and less urgent.

key_arguments.headline: Order status, sizing advice, and late parcel tracking are the best first agents
key_arguments.support: These three tasks are high volume, rules-based, and already supported by Shopify, your shared inbox, and carrier tools. They affect customers directly, so fast replies and fewer mistakes are easy to see. Each agent can start with a human approval step before sending anything.

key_arguments.headline: Run a four-week pilot, keep humans in the loop, then scale proven agents
key_arguments.support: Connect one shared inbox and one carrier account first, then review every drafted reply or update for the first two weeks. Use simple exception rules so refunds, replacements, and unusual cases still go to a person. After the pilot, extend the same agents to more inboxes, carriers, and product categories.

strategy.executive_summary: Tidewell Outdoor sells about 3,000 outdoor products online with a 15-person team in Gothenburg. Most customer questions, returns, stock checks, and reporting still run through email and manual Shopify work. Order and sizing emails arrive faster than your team can answer, and late parcels create repeat contacts that cost time and trust. As sales grow, the same manual steps will absorb more hours without adding capacity. Start with three agents for order status and returns, sizing advice, and late parcel tracking; they cut your team’s repetitive email and parcel work and prove value fast.

maturity.label: Early
maturity.note: You use Shopify and a shared inbox, but most repetitive work is still manual and AI use is limited to occasional experiments.

opportunities.title: Order status and returns triage
opportunities.description: An agent reads incoming order, return, and exchange emails, checks Shopify and carrier status, and drafts a reply with the right next step. It routes refunds, replacements, and complaints to a human for approval. Pilot: first shared inbox and Shopify order data.

Check carrier tracking and return policy
Write reply and update order note
Escalate refunds or delays to lead
after: Agent reads email and finds order in Shopify
Agent checks carrier tracking and return rules
Agent drafts reply and order note
Human: reviews and sends reply or approves refund
Human: handles only exceptions and complaints

opportunities.title: Sizing and product advice replies
opportunities.description: An agent matches customer questions to product specs, size charts, and past answers, then drafts a helpful reply. It flags missing or unclear product data for your content writer to fix.
before: Search product pages and old replies
Copy lead on uncertain fit advice
after: Agent reads question and product ID
Agent pulls specs, size chart, and similar past answers
Agent drafts reply with fit guidance
Human: reviews and sends reply
Human: updates product page when data is missing

opportunities.title: Late parcel tracking and delivery updates
opportunities.description: An agent checks carrier tracking for delayed or lost parcels and drafts customer updates or internal alerts, then updates Shopify delivery status. It tells customer service when a claim or replacement is needed.
before: Check carrier portals for late parcels
Compare tracking to promised delivery date
after: Agent checks carrier data for late parcels
Agent compares dates and drafts customer update
Agent updates Shopify delivery status
Human: reviews and sends update
Human: handles claims and replacements

opportunities.title: Product listing and collection updates
opportunities.description: An agent drafts product descriptions, tags, and collection placements from supplier specs and your style rules. It prepares changes in Shopify for a human to approve before publishing. Pilot: one seasonal camping collection.
after: Agent reads supplier specs and style rules
Agent drafts description, tags, and placement
Human: reviews and edits content
Agent publishes approved product updates
Human: checks one sample per batch

opportunities.title: Stock reorder alerts and supplier order drafts
opportunities.description: An agent checks stock levels against reorder points and drafts supplier orders for low items. It highlights lead times and price changes for the purchasing manager to approve. Pilot: top 100 selling products.
before: Check supplier price and lead time
after: Agent pulls stock and sales data
Agent flags items below reorder point
Agent drafts supplier order with quantities
Human: reviews and sends order
Agent updates purchase record

opportunities.title: Invoice and payout reconciliation
opportunities.description: An agent matches Shopify payouts, carrier invoices, and supplier receipts, then flags mismatches for review. It prepares a simple weekly reconciliation summary for the finance assistant. Pilot: one month of payouts and carrier invoices.

Agent matches amounts and flags differences
Agent prepares reconciliation summary

Human: sends final report or asks supplier

opportunities.title: Site error and speed monitoring
opportunities.description: An agent checks Shopify theme errors, broken links, and page speed daily, then writes a short issue list. It creates a draft ticket or fix note for your developer. Pilot: checkout, product, and home pages.

Agent groups issues by page and severity
Agent drafts developer ticket

opportunities.title: Weekly campaign and traffic digest
opportunities.description: An agent pulls Google Analytics, email, and ad data into a short weekly digest with what changed and what needs attention. It drafts the summary and suggested follow-ups for the marketing team. Pilot: one email campaign and one ad channel.
after: Agent pulls analytics, email, and ad data
Agent compares week over week and flags changes
Agent drafts digest with suggested actions

Human: shares notes with team

roadmap.title: Prove three agents with human review
items: Connect one shared inbox, Shopify order data, and one carrier account
Launch order status and returns triage agent with human approval
Launch sizing and product advice agent using top 50 questions
Launch late parcel tracking agent for one Nordic carrier lane
Review drafts daily and track response time, accuracy, and exceptions

roadmap.title: Extend to marketing, purchasing, and finance
items: Add product listing and collection update agent for one seasonal collection
Add stock reorder and supplier order draft agent for top 100 products
Add invoice and payout reconciliation agent for one month of data
Keep human approval on all customer-facing and spending actions

roadmap.title: Scale, measure, and add new agents
items: Extend agents to more inboxes, carriers, and product categories
Add site error monitoring and weekly campaign digest agents
Set a weekly review of hours saved, errors, and customer feedback
Train team on exception handling and agent maintenance

risks.risk: An agent sends a wrong reply or updates an order incorrectly
risks.mitigation: Require human approval for customer replies during the pilot and keep refunds, replacements, and complaints human-controlled.

risks.risk: Product data is incomplete, so sizing advice is unreliable
risks.mitigation: Start with the top 50 questions, flag missing specs to the content writer, and block answers when key size or fit data is absent.

risks.risk: The team does not trust or adopt the agents
risks.mitigation: Involve customer service and logistics in weekly reviews, show their edits, and adjust drafts based on their feedback.

risks.risk: Carrier or Shopify connections break or hit limits
risks.mitigation: Pilot one carrier and one inbox first, monitor failed checks, and keep a manual fallback process documented.

risks.risk: Saved hours are not redirected to higher-value work
risks.mitigation: Track weekly hours saved and assign that time to product content, supplier negotiations, or customer retention tasks.
